entries.quote: AI accelerator chips, which optimize deep learning workloads, generated $4 billion in revenue last year and should grow 36% at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) to $18 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: AI accelerators

entries.quote: Since 2012, deep learning has created $1 trillion in market capitalization. ARK believes it will add $30 trillion by 2037.
entries.metric: global equity market capitalization created by deep learning
entries.subject: Deep learning
entries.note: First edition to state a calendar year for this claim (earlier: 'in 20 years').

entries.quote: According to our research, streaming revenue should more than quadruple during the next five years, from $86 billion today to $390 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: Streaming revenue

entries.quote: According to ARK's research, OTT ad revenues could increase more than 7x during the next five years, from nearly $6 billion in 2019 to roughly $44 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: OTT advertising

entries.quote: According to ARK's research, music streaming revenue in the US could grow at an average annual rate of 18%, from $8 billion in 2019 to $18 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: Music streaming revenue

entries.quote: Cloud gaming is likely to take share from console- and PC-gaming, growing from nearly $263 million in 2019 to $13.5 billion, or from 0.2% to 6.3% share during the next five years.
entries.subject: Cloud gaming
entries.note: Chart titled '2024 Forecast'; global game market total USD 216 billion in 2024.

entries.quote: Based on Wright's Law, we forecast EV sales will be 37 million units, six-times higher than the forecasting agencies' consensus estimate for 2024.
entries.subject: Electric vehicle sales
entries.note: p26: conditional on automakers scaling EV production; chart adds USD 1.1 trillion revenue.

entries.quote: EVs Are Nearing Price Parity With Gas-Powered Cars
entries.metric: MSRP of a 250-mile-range EV relative to a Toyota Camry
entries.subject: Electric vehicle price parity
entries.note: Chart annotation 'Cross-Over: EVs cost less!' between 2020 and 2022; chart labels suggest about USD 17,000 for a 250-mile EV in 2024. Year of crossover read from chart; mapping not certain.

entries.quote: According to ARK's research, automation will add $800 billion to US Gross Domestic Product (GDP) by 2024, and potentially $12 trillion by 2035.
entries.metric: addition to US GDP from automation
entries.subject: Automation and GDP

entries.quote: By 2035, GDP could hit $40 trillion, nearly 40% higher than would be the case without automation, compounding at a 2.4% growth rate instead of 1.8%.
entries.subject: US GDP
entries.note: Same slide: automation adds USD 12 trillion during the next 15 years.

entries.quote: ARK's Industrial Robot Price Decline Model
entries.subject: Industrial robot cost
entries.note: Chart label '$13,000 2024' on the ARK price-decline curve.

entries.quote: ARK expects robot sales to quadruple during the next five years, from roughly 420,000 in 2018 to 1.6 million in 2024.
entries.subject: Industrial robot sales

entries.quote: ARK believes 3D printing will revolutionize manufacturing, growing from $10 billion in 2018 to $97 billion in 2024 at an average annual rate of 65%.
entries.subject: 3D printing market

entries.quote: ARK's research suggests that the 10-year net present value (NPV) of its cashflows is more than $1 trillion today and should hit $5 trillion by 2024 and $9 trillion by 2029.
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing market value

entries.quote: ARK's research suggests that the 10-year net present value (NPV) of its cashflows is more than $1 trillion today and should hit $5 trillion by 2024 and $9 trillion by 2029.
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing market value

entries.quote: ARK estimates that, at scale, autonomous taxis will cost consumers $0.25 per mile
entries.metric: cost per mile of an autonomous taxi to consumers
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing cost
entries.note: Chart places USD 0.25 at 2024 (with 2021 also on the axis); the text says 'at scale'. Revision from USD 0.35 and USD 0.26.

entries.quote: Ridehailing company platform fees probably will drop from 20-30% today to 1-5% as they evolve into lead generators.
entries.subject: Ride-hailing fees
entries.note: No year stated; captured because it is numeric and is tied to the 2024/2029 autonomous forecast on the same slide. Treat as undated.

entries.quote: Drones should make package delivery inexpensive: more purchase decisions made in-store could move online, pushing global ecommerce from 14% of retail sales in 2019 to 60% in 2030.
entries.metric: ecommerce share of global retail sales
entries.subject: Ecommerce share of retail

entries.quote: At $0.25 per delivery, autonomous parcel drone operators could be targeting a $115 billion market opportunity by 2030.
entries.subject: Drone delivery

entries.quote: We estimate that revenue from drone food delivery could total roughly $116 billion globally by 2030.
entries.subject: Drone delivery

entries.quote: Drone delivery platforms could generate $275 billion in delivery revenue, $49 billion in hardware sales, and $12 billion in mapping revenue by 2030.
entries.metric: global drone delivery revenue (parcel, food, air taxi)
entries.subject: Drone delivery
entries.note: Same sentence: USD 49 billion drone hardware sales and USD 12 billion mapping revenue by 2030.

entries.quote: ARK estimates that NGS revenues will grow 43% at an annual rate, from $3.5 billion last year to $21 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: DNA sequencing revenue
entries.note: Revision of the 2019 edition's USD 20 billion in 2023.

entries.quote: ARK believes that the number of whole human genomes sequenced per year should scale 110% at an annual rate, from roughly 2.6 million in 2019 to 105 million in 2024
entries.metric: whole human genomes sequenced per year
entries.subject: Human genomes sequenced

entries.quote: ARK believes that the average price to sequence a whole human genome will fall to roughly $200 by 2024.
entries.metric: average price to sequence a whole human genome
entries.subject: Genome sequencing cost
entries.note: Footnote: 'ARK adjusted its previous cost of $100 by 2023.'

entries.quote: Improvements in R&D efficiency could add $9 trillion to the market capitalization of therapeutics companies during the next 5 years.
entries.subject: Therapeutics market value
entries.note: Chart title 'Projected Therapeutic Market Capitalization by 2024'. Ambiguous whether USD 9 trillion is the added value or the total in the best case; the headline says 'add'.

entries.quote: In the US, digital wallets could be valued at $800 billion by 2024, 27x the $29.5 billion today.
entries.metric: value of US digital wallet users at bank customer lifetime value
entries.subject: Digital wallets
entries.note: Conditional on each user being valued at USD 3,650, a bank's customer lifetime value.

entries.quote: Estimated 220 million digital wallet users in the US by 2024
entries.subject: Digital wallets

entries.quote: digital wallets will reduce the amount of revolving credit card debt sitting on bank balance sheets from $740 billion in 2018 to $483 billion by 2028.
entries.metric: US revolving credit card debt on bank balance sheets
entries.subject: Credit card debt on bank balance sheets

notes: Cover date February 6, 2020 (PDF re-exported 2020-02-25; file name says 011020). Skipped: about 15 claims without a number or without a date, for example 'the GE9X engine could be largely 3D printed by the late 2020s', 'interest income on banks' credit cards is likely to be cut in half during the next five to ten years' (numeric but only a 5-10 year window; not captured), the Bitcoin section (no numeric dated forecast), and slide-level CAGR labels that repeat captured forecasts.
